domain.text: GitHub/opencode gateway tooling with fail-closed identity filtering, scoped operations, and owner approval checks.

impressions.text: The work delivered a typed gateway for GitHub and opencode, including identity checks, scoped verbs, approval handling, and content-free digests.
The orchestrator praised the identity matching, fail-closed pins, GraphQL error handling, and query parsing, while identifying stale board approvals as a security issue.

The worker stopped twice to request direction: first on missing identity trust anchors, then on the absence of an authorized push route; the orchestrator approved the schema changes and granted a task-scoped push exception.

After round-one review requested fixes for stale approvals, role scoping, and a gateway boundary test, the worker reported addressing all three and the orchestrator verified the revised head before asking the owner to approve it.
